{{Top|leg}}
The '''pulse adaptor module tester''' was a tool used to maintain and repair a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapon. A testing unit, the tool measured the amount of resistance charge that built up in the weapon's barrel due to fault [[static pulse adaptor]]s. A pulse adaptor module tester was included in [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech's]] [[Blaster Repair Kit]].
